security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline file paths, and anti-pattern headings. The three helper scripts do contain real user-controlled filesystem writes through --output paths, but I found no prompt injection, network access, credential exfiltration, or hidden command execution intent.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts write to any path supplied with --output.
remediation.suggestion: Constrain output files to the current project or a dedicated reports directory, and refuse to overwrite existing files unless a force flag is provided.

remediation.issue: Documentation includes setup, Docker, Kubernetes, and package-manager commands without explicit safety guidance.
remediation.suggestion: State that commands are examples for manual execution and should only run after the user reviews the target project and active environment.

content.user_title: Design Software Architectures with Senior Guidance
content.value_statement: Architecture choices are hard to compare across product, scale, security, and team constraints. This skill gives structured guidance, references, and helper scripts for clearer decisions.
actual_capabilities: Provides architecture guidance for React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, mobile, database, cloud, and DevOps stacks.
Documents architecture patterns, system design workflows, and technology decision criteria in reference files.
Includes Python helpers for project architecture checks, dependency analysis, and diagram-oriented reporting.
Can produce JSON reports when a helper script is run with the --json option.
Supports trade-off discussion for scalability, maintainability, performance, security, and integration decisions.
limitations: Reference guides are broad templates, so teams must adapt guidance to their domain and constraints.
Helper scripts currently produce basic placeholder findings rather than deep static analysis.
The skill does not validate cloud accounts, production infrastructure, or live deployment safety.
Users must review any suggested shell command before running it in a real project.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Product Architecture
use_cases.description: Compare frontend, backend, database, and deployment options before the first implementation milestone.

use_cases.title: Review an Existing Codebase
use_cases.description: Use the project and dependency helpers to structure an architecture review and identify improvement areas.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Architecture Decision Record
use_cases.description: Turn trade-offs, constraints, and chosen patterns into a clear decision summary for stakeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Architecture Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for a small project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project structure and summarize the main architecture risks, strengths, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Technical Stack
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate decision support for a new service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare two viable stacks for this product. Include scalability, team skill, cost, security, and maintainability trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Architecture Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a system architecture for these requirements. Include components, data flow, integration points, operational risks, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Migration Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a phased migration from this current architecture to the target architecture. Include sequencing, rollback strategy, dependency risks, and decision checkpoints.

output_examples.input: A team asks whether to use a monolith, modular monolith, or microservices for a new marketplace.
output_examples.output: The skill can return a decision matrix with context, recommended architecture, key risks, and criteria for revisiting the choice.

output_examples.input: A backend project needs an architecture review before scaling traffic.
output_examples.output: The skill can outline service boundaries, database concerns, caching options, deployment risks, and prioritized improvement steps.

output_examples.input: A mobile and web product needs a shared API strategy.
output_examples.output: The skill can compare REST, GraphQL, and backend-for-frontend options with trade-offs for client teams and operations.

best_practices: Start with clear product constraints, traffic expectations, compliance needs, and team skills before choosing patterns.
Record decisions with alternatives, trade-offs, risks, and the conditions that would trigger a future review.
Run helper scripts on a copy or controlled workspace, and review output paths before writing reports.
anti_patterns: Do not choose microservices only because the system may grow later.
Do not run deployment or package commands from examples without reviewing the active environment.
Do not treat template recommendations as a substitute for domain-specific architecture review.

faq.question: Does this skill build the architecture automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, examples, and helper scripts that support human architecture decisions.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include executable scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Python helper scripts that analyze a target path and can write JSON reports.

faq.question: Should I run the example shell commands directly?
faq.answer: Review every command first. Some examples affect dependencies, containers, or Kubernetes environments.

faq.question: What architecture topics are covered?
faq.answer: It covers patterns, system design workflows, technology choices, quality checks, scalability, security, and maintainability.

faq.question: What are the main safety considerations?
faq.answer: Use controlled paths for script output and avoid running deployment commands against production contexts without review.
